column1: # Twenty-seven purchase notices for AI computing dated Oct 13 to Nov 24, 2026, opened and saved on Nov 24, 2026 from four universities' own purchasing sites (5 notices) and from the static lists of the national government-procurement site (ccgp.gov.cn, 22 notices), each read from its saved page: one row per notice. A reading sample, not a census. Columns: the page's own date; buyer; project; stage (tender, result or award; "service" marks computing bought as a service); quantity and kind; value in yuan as the page gives it (an award's price or a tender's budget); the chip words as printed ("none" when the page names no accelerator maker or model); nvidia (named | model named, maker not written | no); home_made (the words of a home-made requirement or a home-made product named; "no-import line" or "imports not accepted" where the notice refuses imported products; "domestic-standard declaration" where an award or result notice attaches the supplier's declaration on the home-made product standard, 本国产品标准; none, or "none required" where a result's goods table prints the goods' origin, 原产国 中国 on two results of Fudan University, beside the supplier as maker: an origin field is neither a requirement nor a chip named); the saved id; cuts (FOR | AGAINST | CONTEXT, as in tables/procurement_records.tsv). The counts: 2 notices name an Nvidia model (Fudan University, cards named 英伟达RTX Pro6000; Southeast University, model H100, the maker not written); 5 name or require home-made computing (cuts FOR); 20 name no accelerator maker or model (cuts CONTEXT); 8 refuse imported products; 6 attach the declaration (two of the six cells were completed from the saved pages on Nov 25, 2026). 7 of the 27 notices are also cited in tables/procurement_records.tsv. What the table is not: a tender is not a purchase, and an award or a result is a contract decision, not a delivery and not an import; a notice that names no chip says nothing of the chips in the machines; and the 27 are what was opened in one reading, not all the notices of those weeks.
